name: moodle-mcp
description: Read one Moodle site through its web-service API, limited to an allow-list of courses. It cannot start or see quiz attempts, submit, post, send, mark as read or record a view
long_description:
A local MCP server written in Swift that reads one Moodle site through the REST web-service API with a token kept in the login keychain.

Read-only by construction: the web-service functions are a fixed list in code, quiz attempts, submissions, uploads, forum posts, messages, mark-as-read, view logging and completion changes are refused before any request, and there is no generic call tool.

The site and account are set once with `moodle-mcp login`. Only the courses confirmed with `moodle-mcp selftest --discover` can be read; answers that mention other courses are filtered.

If the token expires, run `moodle-mcp login` in Terminal.

tools.name: moodle_status
tools.description: Read-only. Whether the stored token works, the Moodle release, the user id and name, and which needed functions the site does not grant.

tools.name: courses_list
tools.description: Read-only. The allowed courses with id, full name and short name. Other courses are never shown.

tools.name: course_contents
tools.description: Read-only. One allowed course's sections and modules: type, dates, your completion and files with token-free URLs. Records no view.

tools.name: file_download
tools.description: Saves one file of an allowed course to ~/Downloads/moodle-mcp/<course>/ and returns its path, size and SHA-256. Writes nothing to Moodle; never overwrites.

tools.name: assignments_list
tools.description: Read-only. Assignments with their dates, maximum grade, introduction, your submission's status and your grade. Never submits.

tools.name: quizzes_list
tools.description: Read-only. Quiz dates, time limit, attempts allowed and your attempts' state and grade. Never questions or answers; cannot start or open an attempt.

tools.name: events_list
tools.description: Read-only. Calendar action events (deadlines) of the allowed courses between two dates.

tools.name: notifications_list
tools.description: Read-only. Your notifications attributable to an allowed course, newest first. Does not mark them read.

tools.name: forums_list
tools.description: Read-only. Forums of the allowed courses with discussion and unread counts.

tools.name: forum_discussions
tools.description: Read-only. One page of a forum's discussions with author, dates, replies and the first message. Cannot post.

tools.name: discussion_posts
tools.description: Read-only. Every post of one discussion as plain text with the HTML apart, and attachments. Does not mark read; cannot reply.

tools.name: conversations_list
tools.description: Read-only. Your message conversations with members, last message and unread count; other courses' group conversations dropped. Cannot send.

tools.name: conversation_get
tools.description: Read-only. Messages of one conversation, newest first. Does not mark them read; cannot send.

tools.name: grades_get
tools.description: Read-only. Your grade items in one allowed course: grade, range, percentage, weight and feedback.

tools.name: profile_get
tools.description: Read-only. Your custom profile fields (such as the exam venue) and city; nothing else from the profile.
